# Tic Tac Toe Online — Classic 3x3 Strategy Game (Raxzen)

> Official Website: https://tic-tac-toe.raxzen.in/
> Creator: Raxzen | Location: India | Last update: This month

## Summary
Tic Tac Toe (Noughts and Crosses) by Raxzen is a free, instant, zero-download 3x3 strategy board game for desktop and mobile browsers. Players can challenge a smart, logic-based AI opponent or play 2-player local matches on a single device with a warm tabletop interface, live scoreboard, and interactive sound effects.

## Core Features & Game Modes
- **Vs Computer (Smart AI)**: Single-player mode where the AI checks for winning moves, blocks opponent threats, and plays tactically.
- **Vs Friend (2-Player Local)**: Classic X vs O pass-and-play mode on one screen.
- **Live Scoreboard**: Real-time win tracking for X and O across rounds.
- **Interactive Audio & Tabletop UI**: Responsive controls, crisp sound effects, and adaptive performance for smooth play on low-end (500MB RAM) to high-end devices.
- **PWA Support**: Installable as a lightweight offline-capable web app.
